summary: persistRecipeDraft enqueued recipe-enrichment before the caller's own transaction committed on the batch-import path, silently losing eager enrichment for every imported recipe until a manual backfill
evidence: recipe-import.ts:1300 calls persistRecipeDraft(trx, ...) inside commitImport's db.transaction().execute(); persistRecipeDraft's original unconditional 'await enqueueEnrich(recipeId)' ran inside that open trx. Reverting the db.isTransaction guard (sed 's/if (ownsTransaction)/if (true)/') reproduced it: the new recipe-import.db.test.ts regression test failed with uncommittedEnqueues == 3 committed-import ids, proving enqueueEnrich saw recipeIds not yet visible on a separate pooled connection. Restoring the guard made the same test pass (43/43).
